# Agent with REA / app2cli

Purpose: analyze applications with REA, author semantic adapters, compile per-app CLIs, execute and verify.

Discover: `app2cli --help`, `app2cli list`, `<app>-cli --schema`, `<app>-cli --capabilities`.
Generate: `app2cli generate <url|apk> --out <new-run-dir> [--id name] [--goal text]`. Requires authenticated Codex CLI and REA. Performs real tests and bounded repairs; no bundled adapter lookup. Test contracts: reversible value/content replacement, or Android multi-screen navigation with --scenario android-journey. Navigation restores a declared screen, not exact feed/history state. Capability declarations and actual accepted scenarios are separate. See docs/generation.md.
Reverify: `app2cli verify <completed-run-dir> --out <new-report-dir>` against the original live session, without another model call.
Analyze: `app2cli inspect web <owned-cdp-url> --target <id> --out <evidence-dir>` or `app2cli inspect android <apk> --class <class> --method <method> --out <evidence-dir>`.
Draft: `app2cli scaffold --id <id> --evidence <dir> --out <new-adapter-dir>`.
Author: implement adapter.json and adapter.mjs according to docs/adapter-contract.md. Drafts are blocked from compilation.
Compile: `app2cli build <adapter-dir> --evidence <dir> --out <new-package-dir>`.
Call: `<app>-cli <group> <verb> --input '{...}' --request-id <stable-id>`.

All command results are JSON on stdout; progress is stderr. Read schemas before constructing inputs. Reuse request IDs only for the identical mutation. Pass a prior revision with --expected-revision when acting on previously observed state. --dry-run reads and plans without dispatching. Unknown or unverified outcomes require inspection, not blind retries.

Build success does not prove runtime success. Verify actual application effects and preserve unrelated data. Report verification levels accurately: native-ui-readback, reload-persisted, and server-confirmed are different evidence standards. Current bundled examples: TodoMVC Web and Fossify Calculator Android. The generator is not guaranteed to cover arbitrary apps; iOS, desktop and Android internal-method invocation are not implemented.

Recorded unseen-app generations: Dillinger from a live URL and Editor 1.98 from an APK. See docs/generation-acceptance.json and docs/android-generation-acceptance.json. Generated source is preserved under examples/, not selected by the generator. The independent observer checks the native baseline, dry-run, mutation and restoration; Android snapshots include hierarchy hashes and a supporting screenshot. Android buffer readback is not file persistence.

Douyin Android experiment: docs/douyin-android.md and docs/douyin-android-acceptance.json. Generated extension source: examples/douyin-generated/. Logged-out browsing/search only, pinned APK 32.2.6. Use --capabilities to distinguish declared features from concrete accepted scenarios. Native UI execution does not establish a recovered private API or complete app coverage. One test-oracle correction was explicitly reviewed, not hidden as automatic repair.

API-first: use generate <backend-origin> --transport http --capture private.har --api-case owned.json. Agent maps observed endpoints into the shared HTTP resource adapter; independent GET confirms writes and restoration. Auth values stay in environment. URL/APK alone does not yield universal API access. UI/native-function generation requires --allow-ui-fallback. The reviewed Douyin browser-api sample is read-only and retains the original browser signing/session chain. See docs/api-first.md and docs/api-first-acceptance.json.
